assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 叙事带涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 文化叙事素材仅作概念性公开信息整理与来源标注，不替代权威史料研究，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Narrative materials are concept-level public-information compilations only, not authoritative historical research.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三源叙事馆、跨界对话廊与新文化策展舱设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 观展与互动仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Exhibition interaction and visitor sensing process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三源文化季、跨界对话周与新文化策展日等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 老年、残障、儿童照护、低数字与无设备旅程均提供人工/纸本/触觉/声音替代，不以设备使用作为服务前提。
assumptions.statement_en: Older, disabled, caregiver, low-digital and device-free journeys have staff, paper, tactile or audio alternatives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 案例、史料、字体、地图、代码和AI输出逐项登记权利状态；reference-only 不等于再发布许可。
assumptions.statement_en: Cases, sources, fonts, maps, code and AI outputs are itemized; reference-only is not a redistribution license.

assumptions.statement_zh: 五地协同是待核的条件性接口，不代表现有合作、招商或政策承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Regional synergy is a conditional interface pending verification, not an existing partnership or policy commitment.
